units.text: The 2019 International System of Units (SI) defines the base unit for electric current as the ampere (A).

citations.title: The International System of Units (SI), 2019 Edition

judgement.reason: The 2019 SI edition lists electric current as a base quantity with base unit ampere (A), and states 'The ampere, symbol A, is the SI unit of electric current.'

units.text: The kelvin (K) is defined in the 2019 SI as the base unit for thermodynamic temperature, not for electric current.

citations.title: The International System of Units (SI), 2019 Edition

judgement.reason: The passage lists kelvin (K) as the base unit for thermodynamic temperature and ampere (A) as the base unit for electric current, so K is not the electric-current unit.
